title: Secondary Inbox Neglect Risk
dataSources: Breach alerts (`breach:alert`), inbox stats (`inbox:stats`), cloud-drive usage (`clouddrive:usage`), certificate expiry (`certexpiry:check`).
app: Personal cybersecurity feeds — Have-I-Been-Pwned breach alerts, personal email/inbox stats, cloud-storage usage APIs, and personal TLS-certificate expiry checks — sent to Splunk HEC via scripted inputs.
spl:
index=personal sourcetype=inbox:stats account_role=backup
| stats latest(_time) as last_seen, latest(unread_count) as unread_count by account
| eval days_since=round((now()-last_seen)/86400,0), neglected=if(days_since>14,1,0)
| sort - days_since
description: Flags backup or secondary inboxes that have not been reviewed recently.
value: Neglected secondary accounts are where password resets, billing notices, and breach warnings can quietly pile up.
implementation: Label backup or secondary accounts in inbox stats and alert when they have gone unchecked beyond your threshold.
visualization: Table of secondary inboxes with days since last check and unread count.
grandmaExplanation: It compares which backup email accounts have been left unchecked long enough for important notices to pile up unnoticed.
